messages:
maria: Quick sync on eval run modal — two paths in mock: full `Run suite` and lightweight `Preview run` (5 samples). Need final copy + a11y checks. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz jay: I like explicit `Run suite`. Add helper line under CTA: 'Estimated time: ~2m · Estimated cost: $0.05' so people see impact. oliver: Agree. Also propose conditional confirmation for big jobs (prompts >500 OR cost > $5) with a checkbox 'I understand this will consume credits'. Avoid annoyances for small runs. kira: Accessibility nits: secondary button contrast fails AA in current mock; focus ring clipped on dark theme; DOM focus order currently has close X after CTAs which confuses keyboard flow. design-bot: lint: contrast ratio .secondary-btn = 3.7:1. Recommend #475569 or increase font weight to pass AA. maria: Copy proposal: primary: `Run suite` (aria-label='Run the selected test suite'). helper (muted): 'Estimated time: ~2m · Estimated cost: $0.05' (sentence case). Big-run inline warning: 'This run will process 1,200 prompts and may take about 30 minutes. Estimated cost: $12.00.' jay: Add keyboard hint: 'Press R to run' in header and ensure Escape closes modal and returns focus to origin. Telemetry names: eval_run_initiated, eval_run_confirmation with props {suite_id, prompts_count, estimated_cost_usd}. kira: Add aria-live='polite' to helper line so screen readers announce ETA/cost when modal opens. role='dialog' aria-modal='true' and visible focus trap. Honor prefers-reduced-motion for progress bars. oliver: Preview flag backend ok. call it preview=true. Toggle shows small 'Preview' badge on the quick button. Log event eval_run_preview_used. Make confirmation checkbox conditional and behind a flag for tuning. maria: Dev snippet:

Estimated time: ~2m · Estimated cost: $0.05

jay: LGTM. Data infra to map telemetry names. Also include triggers: eval_run_confirm_shown, eval_run_confirm_accepted. kira: Final a11y checklist before handoff: 1) AA contrast 2) keyboard focus trap/order 3) screen reader announces ETA/cost 4) target sizes >=44px 5) reduced motion respected. maria: I'll update Figma and open a dev ticket with copy, aria attrs, thresholds, and telemetry. Please react :thumbsup: if you approve or comment if not. Thanks! :sparkles:
